in_hebrew.name: Calypso
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Beautiful, Hidden One
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Calypso הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Calypso was a nymph who kept Odysseus captive on her island for seven years. The name Calypso comes from the Greek word 'kalos' meaning 'beautiful' and 'psyche' meaning 'soul' or 'hidden one'.

in_greek.name: Καλύπσω
in_greek.long_meaning: from the Greek word καλύπτω (kalypto) meaning 'to cover, hide, conceal'

in_latin.name: Calypso
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Beautiful, Hidden One
in_latin.long_meaning: Calypso est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. In Greek mythology, Calypso was a nymph who kept Odysseus captive on her island for seven years. The name Calypso comes from the Greek word 'kalos' meaning 'beautiful' and 'psyche' meaning 'soul' or 'hidden one'.
